name: Immich-Kiosk
description: Highly configurable slideshow and digital photo frame for displaying assets from an Immich server.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent Immich Kiosk configuration. Store config.yaml and related configuration files here. Change the FAST pool name if your MOS appdata is stored elsewhere.

variables.name: Immich URL
variables.description: Required. URL used by Kiosk to reach Immich, for example http://192.168.1.4:8084 or an internal DNS name.

variables.name: Immich API Key
variables.description: Required. Immich API key used by Kiosk.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Locale used by the container. Change to match your preferred locale.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used by Immich Kiosk. Example: Europe/Madrid.

variables.name: Duration
variables.description: Number of seconds each slide is displayed.

variables.name: Image Fit
variables.description: Image fitting mode: none, contain or cover.

variables.name: Background Blur
variables.description: Display a blurred copy of the current image as the background.

variables.name: Transition
variables.description: Slide transition effect. Supported examples include none, fade and cross-fade.

variables.name: Show Progress Bar
variables.description: Show a progress bar for the current slide.

variables.name: Prefetch
variables.description: Fetch upcoming assets in the background for smoother transitions.

variables.name: Kiosk Password
variables.description: Optional password protecting access to the Kiosk.
